# ComfyUI Workflow Inspector

ComfyUI Workflow Inspector is a browser-only static tool for inspecting ComfyUI
UI workflow exports and prompt API JSON before hosting, repairing, or moving a
workflow to services such as RunningHub, Comfy Cloud, RunPod, or a private API.

The tool parses JSON locally in the browser and does not upload workflow files.
It reports output-like nodes, preview-only branches, duration/frame/FPS fields,
prompt-bearing nodes, seed fields, model references, and a copyable repair brief.

The workflow diff page compares two workflow JSON files locally and reports added
nodes, removed nodes, node type changes, changed fields, output node changes, and
a copyable migration brief.

The RunningHub output retrieval planner identifies preferred final output node
ids, preview or temp nodes to avoid, ComfyUI `/history/{prompt_id}` lookup paths,
`/view` download steps, and a copyable hosted retrieval brief.

The history artifact extractor parses completed ComfyUI `/history` JSON,
extracts downloadable image/video/audio artifacts, builds `/view` URLs and curl
commands, flags preview or temp files, and generates a copyable output evidence
brief.

The acceptance evidence builder combines workflow JSON and `/history` output
into a final deliverable list, preview exclusion notes, curl commands, delivery
files, and a copyable client signoff report.

The parameter mapper identifies prompt, seed, dimension, timing, media upload,
and model fields that should become hosted API inputs, then generates source
paths and a copyable integration brief.

The dependency scanner identifies custom node package groups, unknown node
classes, model/checkpoint references, media file references, ffmpeg-sensitive
video nodes, and a copyable host setup brief.

The asset manifest builder turns workflow JSON into a host-ready model and media
manifest, including folder placement, media upload steps, verification checks,
JSON output, and a copyable setup handoff.

The API smoke test builder identifies the preferred output node, preview-output
risks, bindable parameters, `/prompt`, `/history/{prompt_id}`, `/view`, and
websocket endpoints, then generates curl commands and a copyable smoke test
handoff brief.

The safe share tool redacts workflow JSON and logs locally before handoff. It
removes API keys, authorization headers, provider tokens, sensitive URL query
parameters, local filesystem paths, private hosts, and email addresses while
keeping node ids, filenames, model names, and repair context useful.

The failure log triage tool classifies ComfyUI, RunningHub, and hosted API logs
into missing custom nodes, missing assets, prompt validation, GPU memory,
torch/CUDA, tensor shape, ffmpeg, output retrieval, and network/auth failures,
then generates blockers, priority actions, evidence checks, and a copyable
repair handoff.

The repair brief builder combines workflow JSON and optional failure logs into a
checkout-ready repair scope covering custom nodes, model and media assets,
runtime parameters, final output retrieval, hosted API verification, and a
copyable private setup handoff.

The setup quote builder estimates hosted workflow setup complexity, recommends a
setup tier, lists score drivers, builds dependency/runtime/output/evidence scope,
and generates a copyable quote brief with a setup deposit link.

The deployment handoff builder combines dependency, parameter, retrieval, and
API smoke-test checks into setup steps, runtime input maps, output contracts,
acceptance evidence, client delivery files, and a copyable hosted workflow
handoff brief.

The support intake packet builder combines workflow JSON, failure notes, target
platform, optional history output, assets, runtime inputs, missing evidence,
open questions, blockers, checkout link, and a copyable paid setup request.

The support page collects the setup deposit, private repair intake, billing,
public proof, GitHub profile, and optional Ko-fi support links in one static
entrypoint.
